notes.title: Making the early game more approachable
notes.content:
Version 1.0.6
[i]15 March 2025[/i]
- Lowered the amount of enemies on the first wave
- Increase the amount of time before the second wave spawns
- Increased pulse items damage and added 1 bounce
- Increased normal enemy XP

notes.title: More bugfixes and improvements
notes.content:
A combination of bug fixes and UI improvements to make early game easier son you can get into flow easier.

Version 1.0.5
[i]14 March 2025[/i]
- Added full explanation of each ability (including upgrades) to Ability picker
- Increased Boomerang healing to 20%
- Added 1 more slow stack to Galaxy

Version 1.0.4
[i]13 March 2025[/i]
- Added shield item that can be picked up
- Increased amount of items that spawn

Version 1.0.3
[i]12 March 2025[/i]
- Fixed tutorial text bugs
- Fixed tertiary ability to stop resetting after a run

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Adding items[/h2]
I have added 3 different item types that randomly spawn every wave - Health, Speed & Pulse laser. This is in a response to biggest feedback - early game is a little bit too hard. This should make it easier to get powerful upgrades later.

[h2]Version 1.0.2[/h2]
[i]Released on 10 March 2025[/i]
- Lowered barrage volume
- Lowered reflected lasers volume
- Updated color of Experience bar and tertiary ability
- Updated Chaos and Precision bounce icons and renamed to charge for better understanding what it does
- Lowered the amount of projectile hit VFX for better readability
- Updated player animation to include more frames in general and more frame per second
- Increased visibility of enemy projectiles
- Increased visibility of some enemies
- Added spawning of items that give you HP, Speed or Explode with projectiles

[h2]Version 1.0.1[/h2]
[i]Released on 8 March 2025[/i]
- Fixed a bug with trusty rusty not doing anything
- Updated hit sounds to have more impact when hitting characters
- Updated hit colors of enemies to be more visible
- Updated sound distance algorithm to work properly
